adv007Ambidextre.name: Ambidextrous
adv007Ambidextre.description: Can use both hands without penalty. No penalty for using the non-dominant hand.

dis006Begaiement.name: Stutter
dis006Begaiement.description: Speech difficulty. -10% to spells requiring incantation under stress.

adv005BonneMemoi.name: Good Memory
adv005BonneMemoi.description: Exceptional memory. +10% to Library rolls and academic skills for remembering information.

adv001Chanceux.name: Lucky
adv001Chanceux.description: The character is naturally lucky. Once per session, they may reroll a failed roll.

adv009Empathique.name: Empathic
adv009Empathique.description: Senses the emotions of others. +10% to Empathy and Psychology rolls.

dis007Impulsif.name: Impulsive
dis007Impulsif.description: Acts before thinking. Must succeed a POW×3 roll to refrain from acting impulsively in tense situations.

dis001Maladroit.name: Clumsy
dis001Maladroit.description: Tendency to break things. -10% to DEX rolls for delicate actions.

dis004MalChance.name: Unlucky
dis004MalChance.description: Bad luck persists. Once per session, the GM may force a reroll on a successful roll.

dis008MauvVue.name: Poor Eyesight
dis008MauvVue.description: Deficient vision. -20% to Sight rolls without glasses. If glasses are lost, permanent penalty until recovered.

dis002Phobique.name: Phobia
dis002Phobique.description: Irrational fear of something (spiders, heights, water...). Stress +10% in the presence of the stimulus.

adv010Animagus.name: Animagus Potential
adv010Animagus.description: Possesses the rare potential to become an Animagus. Requires long and difficult training (level 5+).

adv008Resistant.name: Magic Resistant
adv008Resistant.description: Naturally resists spells. +10% to opposition rolls against spells.

adv004Seduisant.name: Charming
adv004Seduisant.description: Natural charisma. +10% to Persuasion/Bluff rolls with people who might be attracted.

axGryCourageux01.name: Courageous
axGryCourageux01.description: Once per scenario, the player can show tremendous bravery during an action (rescue, combat to help a friend, etc.). This grants a +30% bonus to all actions during that act.

axGryForceAme02.name: Fortitude
axGryForceAme02.description: Grants a +25% bonus to rolls resisting fear when fighting malevolent creatures or under a spell of that kind.

axGryTemeraire03.name: Reckless
axGryTemeraire03.description: You tend to confuse courage with recklessness and put yourself in dangerous situations without realising until it's too late.

axPouJusticier01.name: Righteous
axPouJusticier01.description: Once per scenario, the player can invoke their code of honour to prevent a malicious act. This grants a +30% bonus to all actions during that act.

axPouCodeMoral02.name: Moral Code
axPouCodeMoral02.description: You have a strict moral code that dictates your daily actions. For example, you can only act in self-defence, cannot cheat, must keep your word, cannot lie, or must fight injustice. Choose a code in agreement with the GM and stick to it throughout your schooling.

axPouPatience03.name: Patience
axPouPatience03.description: You are patient, which grants a +15% bonus to magical research, object enchantments, and long/complex rituals. Also reduces potion preparation time by 1/3.

axSerCerebral01.name: Cerebral
axSerCerebral01.description: You tend to overthink before acting, losing precious time in perilous situations. This translates to a -1 penalty when determining initiative.

axSerErudition02.name: Erudition
axSerErudition02.description: You are naturally gifted in an intellectual skill. Choose a 'knowledge', 'myths & legends', or 'languages' skill. You gain +15% in that skill (can exceed the 50% creation cap). Experience rolls in this skill grant 1/3 extra point(s).

axSerSagesse03.name: Wisdom
axSerSagesse03.description: Seeking inner peace and harmony, the wise one walks the path of meditation. New Meditation skill at 15% (max mastery: 95%) allowing relaxation, fatigue/stress recovery, surviving horrible weather conditions, or solving riddles.

axSepDefautPsy01.name: Psychological Flaw
axSepDefautPsy01.description: You have a psychological limitation that hampers your social interactions. You may be ambitious, grumpy, a liar, proud, unscrupulous, touchy, lazy, a snitch, hot-tempered, envious, kleptomaniac, prejudiced, violent, etc.

axSepFourberie02.name: Cunning
axSepFourberie02.description: Once per scenario, the player can use cunning to devise a plan to harm a person/group or break the rules. This grants a +30% bonus to all actions during the execution of this plan.

axSepQuiVive03.name: On the Alert
axSepQuiVive03.description: You naturally gain a +15% bonus to all skill rolls aimed at concealing your misdeeds (vigilance and stealth to avoid being spotted, and persuasion/bluff when justifying yourself).

sp3001Agrandiss.name: Engorgement
sp3001Agrandiss.description: Enlarges the size of an object up to twice its size. Duration: POWer minutes.

sp0001AirChaud.name: Hot Air
sp0001AirChaud.description: Produces a stream of hot air from the wand.

sp4001Alarme.name: Alarm
sp4001Alarme.description: Creates a magical perimeter that alerts the caster if anyone crosses it. Duration: POWer hours.

sp3002Allegresse.name: Cheering Charm
sp3002Allegresse.description: Puts the target in a state of intense happiness. They cannot worry for 1d4+1 hours. POW/POW opposition.

sp1009Allumette.name: Match to Needle
sp1009Allumette.description: Transforms a match into a sewing needle. First transfiguration exercise.

sp6005Amnesie.name: Memory Charm (Obliviate)
sp6005Amnesie.description: Erases specific memories from the target's mind. POW/POW opposition.

sp4002AnimalVerr.name: Animal to Glass
sp4002AnimalVerr.description: Transfigures an animal into glass (goblet, vase, etc.). Duration: permanent.

sp5001AntiApparit.name: Anti-Apparition
sp5001AntiApparit.description: Prevents anyone in the area from Apparating or Disapparating. Duration: POWer hours.

sp4007Antivol.name: Anti-Theft
sp4007Antivol.description: Enchants an object so it cannot be moved or stolen. Cancels Summoning attempts. Duration: permanent.

sp2012Ascension.name: Ascension
sp2012Ascension.description: Slowly raises the target into the air (up to 3 meters). Duration: concentration.

sp4006Attaque.name: Attack
sp4006Attaque.description: Animates nearby objects or creatures to attack a target. Damage: 1d6 per object (min 1).

sp4003Attraction.name: Summoning Charm (Accio)
sp4003Attraction.description: Attracts an object toward the caster from any known distance. POWer km range.

sp6003AvadaKedav.name: Avada Kedavra
sp6003AvadaKedav.description: Unforgivable Curse. Instantly kills the target. No defense possible. FORBIDDEN.

sp5002Aveuglement.name: Blinding Hex
sp5002Aveuglement.description: Temporarily blinds the target. POW/CON opposition. Duration: POWer rounds.

sp4008Beaute.name: Beautification Charm
sp4008Beaute.description: Temporarily improves the target's appearance. APP +3 for POWer hours.

sp3003Blocage.name: Freezing Charm
sp3003Blocage.description: Immobilizes any creature or object in motion. POW/STR or POW/DEX opposition. Duration: POWer rounds.

sp2004Jambencoton.name: Leg-Locker Curse
sp2004Jambencoton.description: The target's legs lock together, preventing them from walking. Duration: several rounds or until counter-curse.

sp6008BouclierDia.name: Diabolical Shield
sp6008BouclierDia.description: Creates an extremely powerful magical shield that blocks all spells of level 5 or lower.

sp0002BoulNeige.name: Snowball
sp0002BoulNeige.description: Creates a magical snowball in the caster's hands.

sp6010Breche.name: Breach
sp6010Breche.description: Opens a temporary passage through magical protections. Duration: POWer rounds.

sp5007BrasierObsc.name: Dark Blaze
sp5007BrasierObsc.description: Creates a magical black fire that cannot be extinguished by normal means. Dispelling spells do not work.

sp6009BrasierPour.name: Purple Blaze
sp6009BrasierPour.description: Creates a blaze of purple flames that only allows those deemed worthy to pass. Duration: permanent.

sp4010BrumeDoree.name: Golden Mist
sp4010BrumeDoree.description: Creates a thick golden mist that disorients anyone who passes through it. Duration: POWer minutes.

sp0003Bulles.name: Bubbles
sp0003Bulles.description: Makes colorful soap bubbles appear from the wand.

sp3012ChaisChat.name: Chair to Cat
sp3012ChaisChat.description: Transfigures a chair into a cat. Duration: permanent.

sp3011Chance.name: Luck
sp3011Chance.description: Increases the target's derived Luck skill by +30%. Duration: POWer minutes.

sp2008ChangeCol.name: Colour Change
sp2008ChangeCol.description: Changes the colour of an object or the target's hair/eyebrows. Purely cosmetic, variable duration.

sp4011CharmeDefen.name: Defensive Charm
sp4011CharmeDefen.description: Creates a protective barrier around the target that blocks spells of level 4 or lower.

sp2002Protego.name: Shield Charm (Protego)
sp2002Protego.description: Creates an invisible shield that blocks spells of level 2 or lower. Duration: 1 round.

sp3004Chatouillis.name: Tickling Charm (Rictusempra)
sp3004Chatouillis.description: Makes the target laugh uncontrollably, inflicting a 60% penalty to all actions. Variable duration (rounds).

sp0004ChauffBois.name: Beverage-Warming Charm
sp0004ChauffBois.description: Warms a beverage contained in a vessel.

sp3005ChauveFuri.name: Bat-Bogey Hex
sp3005ChauveFuri.description: Launches POW Bat-Bogeys at an opponent's face, hindering their movements. Variable duration (rounds).

sp1006Incendio.name: Fire-Making Spell (Incendio)
sp1006Incendio.description: Ignites a targeted flammable object. Does not work directly on living creatures.

sp4004Confusion.name: Confundus Charm
sp4004Confusion.description: The target becomes confused, disoriented, and unable to think clearly. POW/POW opposition. Duration: POWer minutes.

sp2006Conjonctivi.name: Conjunctivitis Curse
sp2006Conjonctivi.description: Swells the target's eyelids, reducing their vision. -25% penalty to sight-based actions for 1d6 rounds.

sp3006ContreEnch.name: Counter-Enchantment
sp3006ContreEnch.description: Immediately ends the effects of a magical enchantment or charm on the target.

sp5006CordeFlam.name: Flame Rope
sp5006CordeFlam.description: Creates a rope of fire that surrounds and immobilizes the target. POW/DEX opposition to break free. Burns: 1d3/round.

sp4005CreatAnimau.name: Animal Creation
sp4005CreatAnimau.description: Creates one or more small animals from surrounding matter. Duration: permanent.

sp0005Creation.name: Temporary Creation
sp0005Creation.description: Creates a small, simple, and fragile object for a few minutes.

sp3007CracheLima.name: Slug-Vomiting Charm
sp3007CracheLima.description: The target starts vomiting slugs uncontrollably for 1d6 hours.

sp5009CrapaudAman.name: Toad to Toadstool
sp5009CrapaudAman.description: Transfigures a toad into a death cap mushroom. Duration: permanent.

sp1008Crochepied.name: Trip Jinx
sp1008Crochepied.description: Trips the target. They must succeed a DEX×5 roll or fall.

sp3008Deflexion.name: Deflection
sp3008Deflexion.description: Deflects a spell of level 3 or lower onto another target.

sp2001Expelliarm.name: Disarming Charm (Expelliarmus)
sp2001Expelliarm.description: Knocks the object held by the target out of their hands. The most common dueling spell.

sp3009Desillusion.name: Disillusionment Charm
sp3009Desillusion.description: Renders the target nearly invisible by camouflaging them like a chameleon. PER/POW opposition to detect. Duration: POWer minutes.

sp1012Detonation.name: Detonation
sp1012Detonation.description: Produces a deafening noise from the wand, frightening nearby creatures.

sp1004Alohomora.name: Unlocking Charm (Alohomora)
sp1004Alohomora.description: Opens a simple (non-magical) lock. Complex or enchanted locks resist.

sp4009Destruction.name: Destruction
sp4009Destruction.description: Violently destroys an object, reducing it to pieces. POW opposition if enchanted object.

sp6001Doloris.name: Cruciatus Curse (Crucio)
sp6001Doloris.description: Unforgivable Curse. Inflicts excruciating pain on the target. One must desire the other's suffering and take pleasure in it. FORBIDDEN.

sp2009Entrave.name: Impediment Jinx (Impedimenta)
sp2009Entrave.description: Considerably slows the target. Movement is halved and -10% to DEX rolls for 1d6 rounds.

sp5003Expulsion.name: Banishing Charm (Depulso)
sp5003Expulsion.description: Violently propels the target backward with considerable force. Damage: 2d6.

sp5004Extension.name: Extension Charm
sp5004Extension.description: Magically enlarges the interior of an enclosed space without changing its exterior appearance. Duration: permanent.

sp1005Collaporta.name: Locking Spell (Colloportus)
sp1005Collaporta.description: Magically locks a door or chest. Moderate resistance to opening.

sp5010FeuSemprem.name: Everlasting Fire
sp5010FeuSemprem.description: Creates an eternal fire that does not burn and never goes out. Used for lighting. Duration: permanent.

sp6006Feudeymon.name: Fiendfyre
sp6006Feudeymon.description: Creates a living demonic fire taking the shape of creatures. Nearly impossible to extinguish. Destroys Horcruxes.

sp0006FloconNei.name: Snowflake
sp0006FloconNei.description: Makes a few snowflakes appear, falling slowly.

sp5005HumainAnima.name: Human to Animal
sp5005HumainAnima.description: Transfigures a human into an animal of similar size. POW/POW opposition. Duration: permanent. Forbidden in most schools.

sp6002Imperium.name: Imperius Curse (Imperio)
sp6002Imperium.description: Unforgivable Curse. Allows total control of a person's will. POW/POW opposition. FORBIDDEN.

sp6007Incartable.name: Unplottable Charm
sp6007Incartable.description: Makes a location impossible to find on a map or by magic. Duration: permanent.

sp1003Wingardiu.name: Levitation Charm (Wingardium Leviosa)
sp1003Wingardiu.description: Levitates a moderate-sized object (max ~10 kg). Duration: concentration.

sp1011Ligotage.name: Binding Spell (Incarcerous)
sp1011Ligotage.description: Magical ropes wrap around the target, immobilizing them. The target may attempt a STR×5 roll to break free.

sp1001Lumos.name: Wand-Lighting Charm (Lumos)
sp1001Lumos.description: Produces a beam of light from the tip of the wand. Illuminates a radius of about 5 meters.

sp0007MagieDome.name: Household Magic
sp0007MagieDome.description: Performs a simple household task (fold a garment, shelve a book, etc.).

sp0008Nettoyage.name: Cleaning Charm (Scourgify)
sp0008Nettoyage.description: Cleans an object or small surface of dirt and dust.

sp2011ObjAnimal.name: Object to Animal
sp2011ObjAnimal.description: Transforms a small object into an animal of corresponding size. The animal disappears after a few minutes.

sp0009Parapluie.name: Umbrella Charm
sp0009Parapluie.description: Creates a small protective screen against rain above the caster.

sp2010PorteVoix.name: Amplifying Charm (Sonorus)
sp2010PorteVoix.description: Amplifies the caster's voice like a magical megaphone. Duration: concentration.

sp6004Portoloin.name: Portkey
sp6004Portoloin.description: Transforms an object into a Portkey that teleports anyone who touches it at the time set by the caster.

sp2005Repoustout.name: Knockback Jinx (Flipendo)
sp2005Repoustout.description: Violently pushes the target back several meters. Deals 1d3 non-lethal damage.

sp2003Riddikulus.name: Boggart-Banishing Spell (Riddikulus)
sp2003Riddikulus.description: Transforms a Boggart into something ridiculous, neutralizing its ability to frighten.

sp0010Ruban.name: Ribbon
sp0010Ruban.description: Makes a coloured ribbon appear from the wand.

sp2007Spongifica.name: Softening Charm (Spongify)
sp2007Spongifica.description: Makes an object soft and spongy. Useful for cushioning falls or making an obstacle deformable.

sp0011Tricot.name: Knitting Charm
sp0011Tricot.description: Makes needles knit magically on their own.

sp1010EclatLum.name: Light Burst
sp1010EclatLum.description: Produces a blinding flash of light for an instant. Nearby targets must succeed a PER×3 roll or be dazzled for 1 round.

sp3010EcranFumee.name: Smokescreen
sp3010EcranFumee.description: Creates a thick cloud of black smoke over an area of POWer meters. Duration: POWer rounds.

sp5008EveilObjets.name: Object Awakening (Piertotum Locomotor)
sp5008EveilObjets.description: Animates a large number of inanimate objects that obey the caster's commands. Duration: concentration.

sp1013Annihilare.name: Annihilare
sp1013Annihilare.description: An ancient variant of the Unlocking Charm, slightly more complex to use but capable of opening doors and locks.

sp1014Arrachegon.name: Door-Wrenching Charm
sp1014Arrachegon.description: Tears a door off its hinges. Was widely used before the importation of the Unlocking Charm.

sp1015Attelle.name: Splint Charm (Ferula)
sp1015Attelle.description: Conjures a splint and prevents a fracture from worsening. Effect: restores 1 hit point.

sp1016Cranechauv.name: Bald Scalp Hex (Calvorio)
sp1016Cranechauv.description: Makes the target's hair disappear (APP -1). Sub-type: Hex.

sp1017Cranechauv.name: Fluorescent Bald Scalp Hex
sp1017Cranechauv.description: Makes all the target's hair fall out and turns their scalp fluorescent (APP -2). Duration: immediate (hair) and variable hours (fluorescence).

sp1018Deliage.name: Unbinding Charm (Emancipare)
sp1018Deliage.description: Frees from magical or non-magical bonds. Counters the Binding Spell.

sp1019Dunamis.name: Dunamis
sp1019Dunamis.description: An ancient variant of the Unlocking Charm, slightly more complex to use but capable of opening doors and locks.

sp1020Etancheite.name: Waterproofing Charm (Impervius)
sp1020Etancheite.description: Enchants a surface to repel substances. Duration: variable (hours).

sp1021Etincelles.name: Green Sparks (Verdimillious)
sp1021Etincelles.description: Releases small green sparks that can cause minor damage to insects and plants. Effect: 1 damage. Range: 1.5m.

sp1022Explosiond.name: Lock-Blasting Spell (Portaberto)
sp1022Explosiond.description: Causes a lock to explode, rendering it unusable.

sp1023Finestra.name: Window-Shattering Spell (Finestra)
sp1023Finestra.description: Shatters a window into tiny fragments without making any noise.

sp1024Flambois.name: Fire Mark
sp1024Flambois.description: Produces an intense red glow from the wand, allowing the caster to draw a flaming mark.

sp1025Fleurmagiq.name: Magical Flowers (Orchideus)
sp1025Fleurmagiq.description: Makes flowers appear at the tip of the wand. Duration: 2d4+2 hours.

sp1026Folleoreil.name: Jelly-Ears Hex (Folloreille)
sp1026Folleoreil.description: Makes the target's ears wriggle frantically, reducing concentration. -5% penalty to spells and concentration tasks. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: variable (rounds).

sp1027Hydrophobi.name: Hydrophobia Charm
sp1027Hydrophobi.description: Makes an object hydrophobic, repelling all liquids that come in contact. Duration: variable (hours).

sp1028Lacer.name: Shoelace-Tying Jinx (Laqueare)
sp1028Lacer.description: Ties the target's shoelaces. DEX×3 to stay standing, 1 round to untie.

sp1029Larmes.name: Tears Jinx (Lacrimare)
sp1029Larmes.description: Makes a person cry, -20% penalty to anything involving vision for 1d4 hours.

sp1030Liberare.name: Liberare
sp1030Liberare.description: An ancient variant of the Unlocking Charm, slightly more complex to use but capable of opening doors and locks.

sp1031Liquidever.name: Liquid-to-Liquid Transfiguration
sp1031Liquidever.description: Transfigures one liquid into another liquid. Duration: permanent.

sp1032LumiereObs.name: Light/Darkness (Lumos/Nox)
sp1032LumiereObs.description: Produces a beam of light (Lumos) or extinguishes all lights in the area (Nox). Duration: voluntary.

sp1033Maleficede.name: Leg-Locker Curse (Locomotor Mortis)
sp1033Maleficede.description: Locks the target's legs together, preventing them from walking. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: variable (rounds).

sp1034Objetenboi.name: Object to Matchbox
sp1034Objetenboi.description: Transfigures an object into a matchbox. Duration: permanent.

sp1035ObjetenOis.name: Object to Bird (Avifors)
sp1035ObjetenOis.description: Transfigures an object into a bird. Duration: permanent.

sp1036ObjetversO.name: Object-to-Object Transfiguration
sp1036ObjetversO.description: Transfigures one object into another object of similar size. Duration: permanent.

sp1038Oiseauxdel.name: Light Birds
sp1038Oiseauxdel.description: Conjures small birds made of light from the wand tip. Duration: permanent.

sp1039Purificati.name: Purification
sp1039Purificati.description: Separates different substances (sorting lentils, removing impurities from powder, removing sand from shoes). Duration: permanent.

sp1040QuatrePoin.name: Four-Point Spell (Point Me)
sp1040QuatrePoin.description: The wand acts as a compass, indicating north. Duration: 1 round.

sp1041Ralentisse.name: Slowing Charm (Leniter)
sp1041Ralentisse.description: Slows small creatures (120cm max) for 1d4+1 rounds. Movement halved. Opposition: POW/DEX.

sp1042Rechauffem.name: Warming Charm (Calefare)
sp1042Rechauffem.description: Heats an object by a few degrees or boils a small quantity of liquid (3L). Duration: instant.

sp1043Recurage.name: Scouring Charm (Récurvite)
sp1043Recurage.description: Cleans dirt by creating soap bubbles or making it disappear. Can also fill a person's mouth with soap. Range: 1.5m. Duration: permanent.

sp1044Refroidiss.name: Cooling Charm (Frigidus)
sp1044Refroidiss.description: Cools a liquid or object down to about 5°C. Duration: instant.

sp1045Repoussede.name: Hair-Regrowth Charm
sp1045Repoussede.description: Causes hair to regrow on the target. Counters the Bald Scalp Hex. Duration: permanent.

sp1046Revelation.name: Revealing Charm (Aparecium)
sp1046Revelation.description: Reveals something hidden by magic or not. Opposition: Level/Level. Duration: instant.

sp1047Rotation.name: Rotation Charm (Circumrota)
sp1047Rotation.description: Rotates objects up to POW×10 m³ in size. Duration: instant.

sp1048Secheresse.name: Drying Charm
sp1048Secheresse.description: Dries small bodies of water. Duration: permanent.

sp1049Sortileged.name: Water-Making Spell (Aguamenti)
sp1049Sortileged.description: Produces water from the tip of the wand. Variable force, from quenching thirst to extinguishing fires. Duration: permanent.

sp1050Sortileged.name: Fire-Making Spell (Incendio)
sp1050Sortileged.description: Conjures flames that can damage objects and burn matter. Deals 1d4 fire damage with 50% chance to ignite. Duration: voluntary.

sp1051Sourisenta.name: Mouse to Snuffbox (Buxulafors)
sp1051Sourisenta.description: Transfigures a mouse into a decorative snuffbox. Duration: permanent.

sp1052Surfacemir.name: Mirror Surface (Mirare)
sp1052Surfacemir.description: Creates a silver reflective surface on a support that mirrors everything passing before it. Duration: 2d4+2 hours.

sp1053Tergeo.name: Cleaning Spell (Tergeo)
sp1053Tergeo.description: Creates a siphon from the wand that removes blood, grease, and other stains from a target. Duration: permanent.

sp1054Valise.name: Packing Charm (Failamalle)
sp1054Valise.description: Makes belongings pack themselves into a suitcase. Duration: 1 minute.

sp1055Ventilatio.name: Airway-Clearing Spell (Anapneo)
sp1055Ventilatio.description: Instantly clears the airways of a choking person. Duration: instant.

sp2013Annulation.name: General Counter-Spell (Finite Incantatem)
sp2013Annulation.description: Immediately cancels all spell effects. Opposition: POW/POW. Does not work on complete transfigurations. Duration: instant.

sp2014Antiouvert.name: Anti-Opening Charm (Colloportus)
sp2014Antiouvert.description: Counters unlocking spells (Alohomora, Annihilare, Dunamis, Liberare). Must be cast differently for each. Duration: POW days.

sp2015Brouillard.name: Fog Spell (Nebulus)
sp2015Brouillard.description: Creates fog from the wand for camouflage. Area: POW×2 meters radius. Duration: variable (hours). Effects: Observation = PER×2.

sp2016Charmer.name: Charm Person
sp2016Charmer.description: The target becomes entranced by the caster. Opposition: APP/POW. Duration: variable (hours).

sp2017Cheveuxdru.name: Hair-Thickening Charm
sp2017Cheveuxdru.description: Makes hair grow disproportionately, obstructing the target's vision. Observation = PER×2. Duration: permanent.

sp2018Colle.name: Sticking Jinx (Agglutino)
sp2018Colle.description: Glues a person's feet or an animal's paws to the ground. Must succeed STR×3 to break free. Duration: variable (hours).

sp2019Couleurdes.name: Hair Colour Charm
sp2019Couleurdes.description: Changes the target's hair colour. Duration: permanent.

sp2020Couleursde.name: Ink Colour Charm
sp2020Couleursde.description: Changes ink colour (to blue, yellow, black, etc.). Duration: permanent or instant.

sp2021CoupeGriff.name: Nail-Trimming Charm
sp2021CoupeGriff.description: Trims claws or nails magically. Duration: instant.

sp2022Cuisant.name: Stinging Hex
sp2022Cuisant.description: Causes burning pain and swells the target's face beyond recognition. Effect: APP -5. Duration: variable (hours).

sp2023Danseendia.name: Dancing Feet Spell (Tarentallegra)
sp2023Danseendia.description: Makes the target dance uncontrollably. -40% to all actions (-20% for magic). Duration: 1d4+2 rounds.

sp2024Deplacemen.name: Telekinesis (Mobili)
sp2024Deplacemen.description: Moves an object or unconscious person by telekinesis. Maximum: POW × 5 kg. Duration: voluntary.

sp2025Descente.name: Descending Spell (Descendo)
sp2025Descente.description: Causes one or more objects to descend or fall. Duration: instant.

sp2026Discretion.name: Silencing Spell (Sonus Evanesco)
sp2026Discretion.description: Greatly reduces sounds made by a person. +30% to Stealth. Duration: 1d4+2 hours.

sp2027Ectoplasmu.name: Ectoplasm Spell (Ectoplasmus)
sp2027Ectoplasmu.description: Cleans ectoplasm and harms spirits and poltergeists. Deals 1d4+1 damage to a spirit's existence points.

sp2028Elasticite.name: Elasticity Charm (Elasticum)
sp2028Elasticite.description: Makes limbs elastic, stretching up to 1 meter. Side effect: -1 STR. Duration: 1 hour.

sp2029Empoigne.name: Grip Charm
sp2029Empoigne.description: Enchants an object to be easier to hold firmly. Duration: permanent.

sp2030Epoximise.name: Sticking Charm (Epoximise)
sp2030Epoximise.description: Makes an object extremely sticky. Requires a spell or STR×2 to release. Duration: permanent.

sp2031Equilibre.name: Balance Charm (Equilibrium)
sp2031Equilibre.description: Prevents being knocked off balance. +50% Athletics for climbing, +40% Acrobatics. Duration: 1d4+1 hours.

sp2032Etincelles.name: White Sparks (Baubillious)
sp2032Etincelles.description: Projects white sparks at an opponent, dealing 1 non-lethal damage. Opposition: POW/POW. Duration: instant.

sp2033Faitdispar.name: Calvorio Hex (Bald-Head)
sp2033Faitdispar.description: Makes the target's hair disappear (APP -1). Sub-type: Hex.

sp2034Ficelage.name: Golden Binding (Fulgaris)
sp2034Ficelage.description: Binds only the target's hands or wrists with golden bonds. Opposition POW/DEX to break free. Duration: permanent.

sp2035Flammesble.name: Bluebell Flames
sp2035Flammesble.description: Creates a small blue flame that is portable and burns even in humid places. Less hot than normal fire but water-resistant. Duration: POW hours.

sp2036Flammesenm.name: Hand Flames
sp2036Flammesenm.description: Generates a fireball in the caster's hand without burning them. Duration: voluntary.

sp2037Fouet.name: Whip Spell
sp2037Fouet.description: Transforms the wand tip into a whip, usable for attacking or grabbing objects at short range.

sp2038Fourrure.name: Fur Spell
sp2038Fourrure.description: Covers the target in fur. Duration: POW hours.

sp2039Freinage.name: Braking Charm
sp2039Freinage.description: Enchants brooms to help brake. Grants +1 to 5% bonus to Broom Flying. Duration: permanent.

sp2040Giclepus.name: Pus-Squirting Hex
sp2040Giclepus.description: Causes profuse pus secretions from the target's nose. APP -1; Smell = PER×1. Duration: 1d4-1 hour(s). Sub-type: Hex.

sp2041GrandeTete.name: Head-Swelling Hex (Engorgio Skullus)
sp2041GrandeTete.description: Doubles the target's head size and weight. -15% to all physical actions and -1 APP. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: 1d4+2 hours. Can be dispelled with a Deflating Draught.

sp2042Herissonen.name: Hedgehog to Pincushion
sp2042Herissonen.description: Transfigures a hedgehog into a pincushion. Duration: permanent.

sp2043Huilegliss.name: Slippery Oil (Scandere)
sp2043Huilegliss.description: Covers a surface with slippery oil. DEX×2 to move across it. Duration: variable (hours).

sp2044Illisibili.name: Illegibility Charm (Illegibilus)
sp2044Illisibili.description: Makes text illegible. Can be lifted by Finite Incantatem. Duration: permanent.

sp2045Inversion.name: Swapping Spell
sp2045Inversion.description: Swaps the position of two objects within POW×2 meters maximum. Duration: instant.

sp2046Lapinenpan.name: Rabbit to Slippers (Soccusfors)
sp2046Lapinenpan.description: Transfigures a rabbit into a pair of slippers. Duration: permanent.

sp2047Liberation.name: Revulsion Jinx (Lashlabask)
sp2047Liberation.description: Forces release or opens bonds, magical or not. Duration: instant.

sp2048Locomotion.name: Locomotion Charm (Locomotor)
sp2048Locomotion.description: Moves objects by levitating and directing them. Duration: variable (rounds).

sp2049Maintien.name: Holding Charm
sp2049Maintien.description: Holds an object in place, making it harder to move or destroy (increases difficulty by 1 level). Duration: permanent.

sp2050Maleficede.name: Melofors Hex (Pumpkin-Head)
sp2050Maleficede.description: Encases the target's head in a pumpkin, blinding them. Sub-type: Hex. Opposition: STR roll to remove. Duration: instant.

sp2051Montage.name: Assembly Charm (Erigo)
sp2051Montage.description: Assembles a structure from parts, like a tent or scaffolding. Duration: instant.

sp2052Objetenplu.name: Object to Quill (Scribblifors)
sp2052Objetenplu.description: Transfigures an object into a quill. Duration: permanent.

sp2053ObjetenPri.name: Object to Prison (Incarcifos)
sp2053ObjetenPri.description: Transforms an object into a prison of the same size. Duration: permanent.

sp2054Obliterati.name: Obliteration Charm
sp2054Obliterati.description: Erases footprints and stains (water, blood, etc.). Range: POW meters. Duration: instant.

sp2055OuvreCaiss.name: Trunk-Opening Spell (Cistem Aperio)
sp2055OuvreCaiss.description: Opens trunks, chests, boxes by violently blowing their lid or doors off. Duration: instant.

sp2056Parole.name: Speaking Charm
sp2056Parole.description: Makes an object speak predetermined phrases — isolated words, increasingly rapid and high-pitched. Duration: POW×3 minutes.

sp2057Poidsplume.name: Feather-Light Charm
sp2057Poidsplume.description: Makes an object as light as a feather. Duration: POW hours.

sp2058Porcepique.name: Porcupine to Pincushion
sp2058Porcepique.description: Transfigures a porcupine into a pincushion. Duration: permanent.

sp2059Ratatinage.name: Shrinking Solution Spell (Reducio)
sp2059Ratatinage.description: Shrinks an object, animal or plant by half for 1d4+2 hours. Counter-spell: Engorgement Charm (Engorgio).

sp2060Renverseme.name: Flipping Jinx (Everte Statum)
sp2060Renverseme.description: Violently trips the target, sending them flying. Deals 1 damage if DEX×3 fails. Duration: instant.

sp2061Repoussecr.name: Creature-Repelling Charm (Exumai)
sp2061Repoussecr.description: Repels an animal as far as possible from the caster. Opposition: POW/STR. Maximum: POW×5 m. Duration: instant.

sp2062Scarabeeen.name: Beetle to Button (Bullatusfors)
sp2062Scarabeeen.description: Transfigures a beetle into a button. Duration: permanent.

sp2063Sortileged.name: Gliding Charm
sp2063Sortileged.description: Enchants an item to glide, following the caster. Duration: POW seconds.

sp2064Spiraledev.name: Wind Spiral
sp2064Spiraledev.description: Creates a spiral of wind around the target. Duration: variable (rounds). Effects: Movement halved.

sp2065Surdite.name: Deafening Hex (Assurdiato)
sp2065Surdite.description: Causes unpleasant buzzing in the target's ears. -50% to hearing Perception. Duration: 1d4 hours. Opposition: POW/POW.

sp2066Tetenbulle.name: Bubble-Head Charm
sp2066Tetenbulle.description: Creates a bubble of pure air around the head, allowing breathing underwater or protection from bad smells. Duration: 1d4+1 hours.

sp2067Videntrail.name: Bowel Hex (Laxativus)
sp2067Videntrail.description: Forces the target to urgently empty their bowels. Sub-type: Hex. Opposition: POW/CON.

sp2068Virage.name: Turning Charm
sp2068Virage.description: Enchants brooms for better turning. Grants +1 to 5% bonus to Broom Flying. Duration: permanent.

sp3013Antihoquet.name: Anti-Hiccup Charm
sp3013Antihoquet.description: Counters hiccup spells or regular hiccups. Duration: instant.

sp3014Antimalefi.name: Anti-Mucus Counter-Hex
sp3014Antimalefi.description: Counters the effects of the Mucus Hex (Mucus ad Nauseam).

sp3015Antitriche.name: Anti-Cheating Charm
sp3015Antitriche.description: Enchants an object (parchment, quill) to prevent anyone using it from cheating. Duration: 1 day.

sp3016Boomerang.name: Boomerang Charm (Cateia)
sp3016Boomerang.description: Enchants an object to always return to its original position when thrown. Duration: permanent.

sp3017Bouchesoud.name: Mouth-Sealing Hex (Oscausi)
sp3017Bouchesoud.description: Makes the target's mouth disappear, sealed by skin. Duration: variable (hours). Effects: Muteness.

sp3018CarpeRetra.name: Carpe Retractum
sp3018CarpeRetra.description: Produces a retractable cord of light to pull objects toward the caster or pull the caster toward fixed targets. Duration: voluntary. Range: POW meters.

sp3019Catapultag.name: Catapulting Jinx
sp3019Catapultag.description: Cast on an object like a broom, violently repels anyone who tries to grab it. Opposition: STR×2. Duration: instant.

sp3020Copieillus.name: Illusory Copy
sp3020Copieillus.description: Creates a visual copy of a person or animal (illusion). PER×1 to see through. Duration: variable (hours). Fades on touch.

sp3021Correcteur.name: Broom Correction Charm
sp3021Correcteur.description: Corrects broom handling. Grants +10% to Broom Flying for the duration. Duration: permanent.

sp3022Cridurut.name: Alarm Spell (Cridurut)
sp3022Cridurut.description: Triggers an alarm if anyone enters the spell's area. Maximum zone: POW meters diameter. Duration: 1 day.

sp3023Diminution.name: Shrinking Jinx (Diminuendo)
sp3023Diminution.description: Shrinks the target to about 30 centimeters. Duration: POW minutes.

sp3024Durcisseme.name: Hardening Charm (Duro)
sp3024Durcisseme.description: Turns small objects into stone. Maximum 5dm³. Duration: 1d6+2 hours.

sp3025Ebublio.name: Ebublio Jinx
sp3025Ebublio.description: Traps the target in a magical bubble. STR×4 to escape. Duration: POW rounds.

sp3026Etincelles.name: Blue Sparks
sp3026Etincelles.description: Projects blue sparks dealing 1d4 non-lethal damage. Opposition: POW/DEX. Can block vision in large quantities. Duration: instant.

sp3027Explosiond.name: Object Explosion
sp3027Explosiond.description: Makes a small object explode violently. Maximum 2dm³. Duration: instant.

sp3028Explosiond.name: Exploding Charm (Bombarda)
sp3028Explosiond.description: Destroys a small object (max 2dm³) by making it explode. Generates a powerful explosion sound. Duration: instant.

sp3029Flottement.name: Floating Charm
sp3029Flottement.description: Makes something float slowly through the air from one place to another, about 1-2 meters off the ground. Duration: voluntary.

sp3030Furoncles.name: Pimple Jinx (Furunculus)
sp3030Furoncles.description: Covers the target in boils and pustules. -2 HP and APP halved. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: variable (hours).

sp3031Gemino.name: Doubling Charm (Gemino)
sp3031Gemino.description: Creates a perfect visual copy of an object (without magical properties). Sub-type: Hex. Cannot be stopped except by the caster. Duration: permanent.

sp3032Glacius.name: Freezing Spell (Glacius)
sp3032Glacius.description: Encases target in ice or freezes liquid surfaces. Duration: 1d6+1 rounds.

sp3033GluPerpetu.name: Permanent Sticking Charm
sp3033GluPerpetu.description: Fixes an object permanently so no one can remove it. Duration: permanent.

sp3034Herbivicus.name: Herbivicus (Plant Growth)
sp3034Herbivicus.description: Accelerates plant growth. Duration: voluntary. Note: ensure sufficient water and nutrients for the plant.

sp3035Hibouenjum.name: Owl to Opera Glasses
sp3035Hibouenjum.description: Transfigures an owl into opera glasses. Duration: permanent.

sp3036Impassibil.name: Impassibility Charm (Impassibilis)
sp3036Impassibil.description: Prevents anything from passing through the enchanted object. Duration: variable (hours).

sp3037Lapifors.name: Lapifors
sp3037Lapifors.description: Transforms an object into a living rabbit of the same size. Can also transform small animals into rabbits. Duration: permanent.

sp3038Lien.name: Protean Charm
sp3038Lien.description: Links objects so that if one is modified, all others change as well. Duration: permanent.

sp3039Maleficede.name: Bat-Bogey Hex (Chauve-Furie)
sp3039Maleficede.description: The target's bogeys transform into bats that attack their face. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: permanent.

sp3040Maleficedu.name: Hiccup Hex
sp3040Maleficedu.description: Makes the target hiccup uncontrollably. Opposition: POW/POW. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: variable (hours).

sp3041Miseenplac.name: Placement Charm
sp3041Miseenplac.description: Precisely places an object at a distance. Duration: voluntary.

sp3042MoucheSard.name: Sardine-Sneezing Hex (Sardina Sternuo)
sp3042MoucheSard.description: Makes the target sneeze sardines. -40% to magic plus pain. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: 2d4+2 hours. CON×3 for effort.

sp3043ObjetenDra.name: Object to Dragon (Draconifors)
sp3043ObjetenDra.description: Transforms an object into a living dragon of the same size. Duration: permanent.

sp3044Objetenpou.name: Object to Chicken (Pullus)
sp3044Objetenpou.description: Transfigures an object into a chicken or goose. Duration: permanent.

sp3045Oscausi.name: Lip-Sealing Hex (Oscausi)
sp3045Oscausi.description: Seals the target's mouth by covering it with skin, making it disappear completely. Duration: permanent.

sp3046Permetdefa.name: Tree Levitation (Mobiliarbus)
sp3046Permetdefa.description: Levitates a tree. It follows the caster as long as concentration is maintained. Duration: voluntary.

sp3047Personneen.name: Human-to-Animal Transfiguration
sp3047Personneen.description: Transforms a person into an animal. Opposition: POW/POW. Duration: permanent.

sp3048Pierreench.name: Stone to Dog
sp3048Pierreench.description: Transforms a stone into a dog of the same size. Duration: permanent.

sp3049Pression.name: Crushing Charm (Deprimo)
sp3049Pression.description: Exerts strong pressure on a surface until it buckles or breaks. Opposition: POW/STR. Duration: voluntary.

sp3050Remplissag.name: Refilling Charm
sp3050Remplissag.description: Refills a container with the liquid it previously held. Duration: instant.

sp3051RepousseFa.name: Ghost-Repelling Charm (Repello Umbrae)
sp3051RepousseFa.description: Prevents ghosts from entering the enchanted zone. Opposition: POW/POW. Duration: 1 day.

sp3052RepousseMo.name: Muggle-Repelling Charm (Repello Moldum)
sp3052RepousseMo.description: Prevents Muggles from entering the enchanted zone. Duration: 1 day.

sp3053Repulsion.name: Banishing Charm (Repulso/Depulso)
sp3053Repulsion.description: Repels an object as far as possible. Can also repel heavy objects (up to POW×5 m). Duration: instant.

sp3054Reveil.name: Reviving Spell (Enervatum)
sp3054Reveil.description: Wakes anyone asleep (magically or not) and anyone hit by Stupefy. Duration: instant.

sp3055Reversion.name: Reversal Spell (Reverte)
sp3055Reversion.description: Returns an object to its original position or state. Can move or repair it. Duration: instant.

sp3056Rocket.name: Rocket Spell
sp3056Rocket.description: Launches the target skyward at high speed. Duration: instant.

sp3057Scellement.name: Sealing Charm (Document)
sp3057Scellement.description: Seals a document so it can only be read after receiving another tap of the wand. Duration: permanent.

sp3058Scellement.name: Room-Sealing Spell (Colloportus)
sp3058Scellement.description: Magically seals a room so it cannot be opened. Duration: permanent.

sp3059Soins.name: Healing Spell (Episkey)
sp3059Soins.description: Restores 1d4+1 hit points and mends bones. Cannot be cast twice on the same wound. Duration: instant.

sp3060Somnambuli.name: Sleepwalking Charm
sp3060Somnambuli.description: Forces a sleeping person to walk during their sleep (magical or not). Duration: POW minutes.

sp3061Stupefixio.name: Stunning Spell (Stupefix)
sp3061Stupefixio.description: Paralyses the target and puts them in a catatonic state near coma. Duration: 2d4+2 hours.

sp3062Terrasseme.name: Gouging Spell (Defodio)
sp3062Terrasseme.description: Carves deep gashes into a surface. Duration: instant.

sp3063Toboggan.name: Slide Charm (Glisseo)
sp3063Toboggan.description: Transforms stairs into a slide. Duration: variable (hours).

sp3064Urticaire.name: Hives Hex
sp3064Urticaire.description: Causes violent hives all over the target's body. Damage: 1d4-2; APP -2. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: instant.

sp3065Waddiwasi.name: Waddiwasi
sp3065Waddiwasi.description: Sends an object flying at bullet speed. May damage it. Duration: instant.

sp4012Antibrumed.name: Anti-brume dorée
sp4012Antibrumed.description: Permet de contrer les effets du maléfice de Cerveau-en-gelée

sp4014Antiscelle.name: Room-Unsealing Spell
sp4014Antiscelle.description: Counters the Room-Sealing Spell. When cast on an object, prevents it from being stolen. Duration: instant.

sp4015Bouledebow.name: Bowling Ball to Balloon
sp4015Bouledebow.description: Transfigures a bowling ball into a balloon. Duration: permanent.

sp4017Escargoten.name: Snail to Teapot
sp4017Escargoten.description: Transfigures a snail into a teapot. Duration: permanent.

sp4018Faitappara.name: Tracking Charm (Appare Vestigium)
sp4018Faitappara.description: Reveals something hidden by magic or not. Opposition: Level/Level. Displays traces of passage and recent magical activity.

sp4019FauxSouven.name: False Memory Charm
sp4019FauxSouven.description: Modifies or adds false memories to a person's mind. Duration: permanent.

sp4020Fidelitas.name: Fidelius Charm
sp4020Fidelitas.description: Hides a secret within a person (Secret Keeper). Only they can reveal it. Duration: permanent.

sp4021Fondantdu.name: Melting Hex (Liquefaciens)
sp4021Fondantdu.description: Causes metal objects to melt. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: instant.

sp4022Gel.name: Ice Trap
sp4022Gel.description: Creates an ice plate on the ground that encases the legs of anyone who steps on it. STR×3 to break free. Deals 2 non-lethal damage. Duration: permanent.

sp4023GeleFlamme.name: Flame-Freezing Charm
sp4023GeleFlamme.description: Makes targeted flames harmless to touch. Duration: variable (days).

sp4024GrandeExpl.name: Major Explosion (Bombarda Maxima)
sp4024GrandeExpl.description: Causes a major explosion, destroying up to 1m³ of matter. Duration: instant.

sp4025Grandeur.name: Aura of Grandeur (Magistratus)
sp4025Grandeur.description: Surrounds the caster with an aura that inspires fear or attraction. Opposition: POW/POW. Duration: 1d10+2 hours.

sp4026Humanite.name: Human Restoration (Homomorphus)
sp4026Humanite.description: Restores human form to a werewolf, Animagus, or transfigured human. Opposition: POW/POW. Duration: instant.

sp4027Incassable.name: Unbreakable Charm
sp4027Incassable.description: Makes an object unbreakable. Duration: POW hours.

sp4028Lumieresol.name: Sunlight Spell (Lumos Solem)
sp4028Lumieresol.description: Produces intense sunlight in an arc of POW×2 meters. Blinds target for 1 round (-50% to sight actions). Damages light-sensitive creatures: 1d4+1.

sp4029Maleficedu.name: Jinxed Wand Hex
sp4029Maleficedu.description: Curses the target so all their spells are cast with maximum penalty. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: variable (hours).

sp4030Maleficedu.name: Laughing Hex (Rictusempra)
sp4030Maleficedu.description: Causes uncontrollable laughter until total exhaustion (0 HP), putting the target in a coma. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: variable (hours).

sp4031Marquedest.name: Dark Mark (Morsmordre)
sp4031Marquedest.description: Conjures the Dark Mark — a giant glowing green skull with a serpent protruding from its mouth. Duration: permanent.

sp4032Mimetisme.name: Mimicry (Mimesis)
sp4032Mimetisme.description: The target's skin adapts to the environment. +50% to Stealth. Duration: 1d10+1 hours.

sp4033Mutisme.name: Silencing Charm (Silencio)
sp4033Mutisme.description: Makes the target mute, preventing spellcasting unless wordless magic is known. Duration: 1 month.

sp4034Patronus.name: Patronus Charm (Expecto Patronum)
sp4034Patronus.description: Summons a Patronus (Opposition: POW×2/POW) that shields against Dementors and similar creatures, or serves as a messenger. Note: requires a pure heart and joyful memory. Duration: voluntary.

sp4035Pintadeenc.name: Guinea Fowl to Guinea Pig
sp4035Pintadeenc.description: Transfigures a guinea fowl into a guinea pig. Duration: permanent.

sp4036Pionenrein.name: Pawn to Queen (Reginafors)
sp4036Pionenrein.description: Transfigures a chess pawn into a queen piece. Duration: permanent.

sp4037Protection.name: Shield Charm (Protego)
sp4037Protection.description: Divides attacker's POW by 2. Grants opposition roll even when normally not allowed and reduces physical damage by 2. Duration: 1d8+2 hours.

sp4038Reduction.name: Reductor Curse (Reducto)
sp4038Reduction.description: Reduces solid objects to dust. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: instant.

sp4039Renforceme.name: Reinforcement Charm (Fianto Duri)
sp4039Renforceme.description: Strengthens existing magical protections, granting extreme formula effects to an already-cast spell. Duration: same as reinforced spell.

sp4040Revelasort.name: Spell-Revealing Charm (Specialis Revelio)
sp4040Revelasort.description: Reveals what spells have been cast on an object or person. Duration: instant.

sp4041Reviviscen.name: Reviving Charm (Rennervate)
sp4041Reviviscen.description: Restores energy to a weakened, stunned, or unconscious person. Ineffective against Dark Arts. Duration: voluntary.

sp4042Securite.name: Security Alarm
sp4042Securite.description: Alerts the caster if a location is burgled. Used in shops against theft. Duration: 12 hours.

sp4043Seduction.name: Seduction Charm
sp4043Seduction.description: Charms the target into falling in love with the caster. Acts like a love potion. Opposition: APP/POW. Duration: 1d6+1 hours.

sp4044Sortileged.name: Memory Charm (Obliviate)
sp4044Sortileged.description: Erases or modifies specific memories. Opposition: POW/POW. Duration: permanent.

sp4045Sortileged.name: Switching Spell
sp4045Sortileged.description: Swaps two targets — the first becomes the second and vice versa. Duration: permanent.

sp4046Supersenso.name: Super-Sensory Charm
sp4046Supersenso.description: Heightens all senses. Side effects: sensitivity to loud sounds and bad smells. Duration: variable (minutes).

sp4047Tortueentr.name: Tortoise to Trumpet
sp4047Tortueentr.description: Transfigures a tortoise into a trumpet. Duration: permanent.

sp5011Alteration.name: Weather Alteration
sp5011Alteration.description: Alters the weather, returning it to normal. Counters Meteorribilis. Duration: instant.

sp5012Antimalefi.name: Anti-maléfice du
sp5012Antimalefi.description: Permet de contrer les effets du maléfice du Voleur

sp5013AntiTransp.name: Anti-Disapparition Jinx
sp5013AntiTransp.description: Prevents a person from teleporting via Apparition. Duration: variable (hours).

sp5014Chardonnet.name: Goldfinch to Golden Snitch
sp5014Chardonnet.description: Transfigures a goldfinch into a Golden Snitch. Duration: permanent.

sp5015Chaudronen.name: Cauldron to Badger
sp5015Chaudronen.description: Transfigures a cauldron into a badger. Duration: permanent.

sp5016Flagrance.name: Flagrante Curse
sp5016Flagrance.description: Protects an object from theft. Anyone grabbing it without lifting the curse suffers 1d4 burn damage. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: permanent.

sp5017Furetenplu.name: Ferret to Feather Duster
sp5017Furetenplu.description: Transfigures a ferret into a feather duster. Duration: permanent.

sp5018Gnomeennai.name: Gnome to Garden Gnome
sp5018Gnomeennai.description: Transfigures a gnome into a garden gnome statue. Duration: permanent.

sp5019Lancesurun.name: Enhanced Locking Spell (Colloportus Maxima)
sp5019Lancesurun.description: Cast on a door or lock, functions as an enhanced lock that requires advanced unlocking magic. Duration: permanent.

sp5020Legilimens.name: Legilimency (Legilimens)
sp5020Legilimens.description: Enters a person's mind to read thoughts and browse memories. Opposition: POW/(POW×1). Duration: voluntary.

sp5021Maleficeex.name: Blasting Curse (Confringo)
sp5021Maleficeex.description: Causes an explosion that destroys objects and deals 1d6+1 damage to living beings. Sub-type: Hex. Duration: instant.

sp5022Ordureench.name: Rubbish to Raccoon Dog
sp5022Ordureench.description: Transfigures rubbish into a raccoon dog. Duration: permanent.

sp5023Plumeauenf.name: Feather Duster to Ferret
sp5023Plumeauenf.description: Transfigures a feather duster into a ferret. Duration: permanent.

sp5024Positionin.name: Initial Position (Recall)
sp5024Positionin.description: Returns the caster to their initial position (equivalent to POW/2 meters). Duration: instant.

sp5025Regenerati.name: Regeneration (Vulnera Sanentur)
sp5025Regenerati.description: Makes wounds disappear from a lifeless body. Effect: cosmetic healing. Duration: voluntary.

sp5026Roiencorbe.name: King to Raven
sp5026Roiencorbe.description: Transfigures a chess king into a raven. Duration: permanent.

sp5027Sectumsemp.name: Sectumsempra
sp5027Sectumsemp.description: Violently slashes the targeted body part as if by a sword. Target rapidly loses blood. Effect: 1d4+1 damage then 1 per round. Sub-type: Hex.

sp5028Sortileges.name: Priori Incantatem
sp5028Sortileges.description: Forces a wand to reveal its last spells. The spell triggers automatically during certain wand-to-wand duels.

sp5029Tasseenger.name: Cup to Gerbil
sp5029Tasseenger.description: Transfigures a cup into a gerbil. Duration: permanent.
